senses.gloss:
† कण् कण्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To sound.
 2. To cry as in distress.
 3. To go.
 --i. 10, Par. To wink, to cover the eye with the lids.

कण कण,
 I. m.
 1. Grain, Hit. 9, 14; broken rice, Man. 11, 92; also the fine red powder which adheres to the rice berry beneath the husk.
 2. A drop, Bhartṛ. 3, 15; spray, Śāk. d. 55.
 3. A spark, Pañc. 93, 3.
 4. A little bit, Prab. 29, 13.
 II. f. णा, Long pepper, Suśr. 2, 418, 16.
 --Comp.

काण काण (probably a syncope of एक-अक्स्हन् + अ by intermediate काक्ष्ण; cf. Lat. cocles, i. e. *coclo + vit, see शष्प), adj., f. णा.
 1. One-eyed, monoculous, Man. 3, 155.
 2. Perforated, Pañc. ii. d. 74.
 3. Blind, Vedāntas. in Chr. 210, 20; Hit. Pr. d. 11; Bhartṛ. 3, 5 (used of a worn-out coin).
कणप कणप, m. A kind of spear, MBh. 1, 8257; with न् instead of ण्, MBh. 3, 810.
कणभ कणभ, m. A kind of fly (an autumn fly ?), Suśr. 2, 258, 1.
कणशस् कण + शस्, adv. In small pieces, Kumāras. 4, 27.
कणाद कणाद, m. The name of a sage, the founder of the Vaiśeṣika or atomic school of philosophy.
कणान्नता कणान्नता, i. e. कण-अन्न + ता, f. Eating broken rice, Man. 11, 167.

कणिक कणिक, i. e. कण + इक,
 I. m. []
 1. Seed, Bhāg. P. 7, 9, 33.
 2. A proper name, MBh. 1, 5544.
 II. f. का, A drop, Megh. 96.
† कण्ट् कण्ट्, i. 1, Par. To go.

कण्टक कण्टक (the base कण्ट् is a dialect. form of कृन्त् (originally कर्न्त्), the base of the present, etc. of कृत्), m.
 1. A thorn, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 183.
 2. A sharp bone, Man. 8, 95.
 3. An enemy, Pañc. 176, 8; a wicked person, Man. 9, 252; 253.
 4. Stinging pain, Suśr. 1, 93, 4.
 5. Obstacle, Hit. iii. d. 76.
 --Comp.

कण्टकित कण्टकित, i. e. कण्टक + इत, adj., f. ता.
 1. Thorny, Draup. 1, 14.
 2. With bristling hair (a sign of pleasure or love, according to the Hindus), Rājat. 5, 2; Śāk. d. 63.
कण्टकिन् कण्टकिन्, i. e. कण्टक + इन्, adj., f. नी. Thorny, MBh. 1, 2851.

† कण्ठ् कण्ठ्, i. 1, Par., Ātm., i. 10, Par.
 1. To grieve.
 2. To desire, to long for.
 --Cf. उत्कण्ठ्.

कण्ठ कण्ठ (probably a dial. form of *कन्धर, for कन्धर), m.
 1. The neck, Rām. 2, 66, 32 Gorr.
 2. The throat, Mṛcch. 128, 20; Man. 11, 205.
 3. Voice, MBh. 3, 829.
 4. Proximity, Pañc. 247, 14.
 5. The proper name of a Ṛṣi, Rām. 4, 18, 11.
 --When latter part of a comp. adj., f. ठी and ठा, e. g. अश्रु- adj. With tears in the throat, i. e. the voice interrupted by tears, Rām. 2, 74, 28; f. ठी, Daśak. [] in Chr. 191, 3.
 निष्क-,
 I. adj., f. ठी, Wearing a golden ornament on the neck, MBh. 3, 14694.
 II. m. A golden ornament of the neck, 13, 4928.
 नील-,
 I. adj. With a blue throat, MBh. 10, 454.
 II. m.
 1. A peacock, Megh. 77.
 2. A name of Śiva, Rām. 5, 89, 41.
 III. f. ठी, A peahen, 5, 11, 23.
 मुक्त-कण्ठ + म् (vb. मुच्), adv. Aloud, as shouting or crying.
 शिति-, m.
 1. A peacock.
 2. A gallinule.
 3. Śiva.
 श्री-, m.
 1. Śiva.
 2. A proper name.
 सन्न- (vb. सद्), adj. Choked, scarcely able to articulate.
 सूत्र-, m.
 1. A Brāhmaṇa.
 2. A wagtail.
 3. A dove.
कण्ठीरव कण्ठीरव, i. e. कण्ठी- (f. of कण्ठ with the same signification) रु + अ, m. A lion, Pañc. iii. d. 28.

कण्ठ्य कण्ठ्य, i. e. कण्ठ + य, adj.
 1. Being at the throat.
 2. Salutary to the throat.
 3. Guttural.

† कण्ड् कण्ड्, i. 1, Ātm. To be glad.
 --i. 1 and i. 10, Par. To remove the husk of grain.
 --i. 10, Par. To preserve.
 --Cf. कद्.

कण्डन कण्ड् + अन,
 I. n. The chaff, Suśr. 1, 38, 4.
 II. f. नी, A mortar, Man. 3, 68.

कण्डु,
 I. कण्डु, and, usually, कण्डू कण्डू, f. The itch, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 13.
 II. कण्डु, m. The name of a Ṛṣi, Rām. 2, 21, 31.
कण्डूति कण्डूति, i. e. कण्डूय + ति, f. Wantonness, Rājat. 5, 281.

कण्डूय कण्डूय, a denominative derived from कण्डु, Par. (Ātm. MBh. 13, 5023).
 1. To scratch, MBh. 1, 5932.
 2. To rub, Śāk. d. 144.
 3. To stroke, Man. 4, 82.
 खर-कण्डूयित, n. (proverbially) Scratching with a thorn for ‘doing an absurd action,’ MBh. 3, 1329.

कण्डूयन कण्डूयन, i. e. कण्दूय + अन, n.
 1. Itching, Bhāg. P. 8, 7, 10.
 2. Scratching, 3, 31, 26.
 3. Stroking, Vikr. d. 151.
कण्डूयनक कण्डूयन + क, adj. Titillating, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1106.
कण्डूयितृ कण्डूयितृ, i. e. कण्डूय + तृ, m., f. तॄ, n. Who or what rubs, Ragh. 13, 43.
कण्व कण्व, m. The name of a Ṛṣi, MBh. 1, 2874. Superl. कण्व + तम, The first of the Kaṇva tribe, Chr. 287, 4 = Rigv. i. 48, 4.
काणेलीमातृ काणेली-मातृ, m. An abusive word; according to glosses: A [] son of an unmarried woman, Mṛcch. 14, 5.

काण्ड काण्ड, m. and n.
 1. The part of a plant from one joint to another (ved.).
 2. A slip, Man. 1, 46.
 3. A stalk, Rām. 2, 91, 15.
 4. A switch, Rām. 2, 89, 19 (97, 24 Gorr.).
 5. An arrow, Hit. 85, 5.
 6. The section of a book, Bhāg. P. 4, 24, 9; Rām. (title of the first, of the second book, etc.); e. g. आरण्यक-, The section comprising the sojourn in the forest (title of the third book).
 7. A bone, Suśr. 2, 31, 5.
 8. A multitude, Mālav. d. 43; Rām. 1, 30, 15 (corr. काण्ड for कण्ड).
 --Comp.
काण्ड- + पट काण्ड- + पट, m. a curtain, Daśak. 122, 6.
काण्ड- + पृष्ठ काण्ड- + पृष्ठ, 1. m. a soldier, MBh. 13, 1593. 2. the husband of a Vaiśya female. 3. the bow of Karṇa.
कण्ठ-निवेशित-हस्त- + युगल कण्ठ-निवेशित-हस्त- + युगल (vb. विश्), adj., f. ला, with (both her) hands put to (her) neck, i. e. with her head leaning on her hands, Pañc. 226, 19.
कण्ठ- + शालूक कण्ठ- + शालूक, n. a swelling in the throat, Suśr. 1, 306, 14.
कण्ठ- + सूत्र कण्ठ- + सूत्र, n. a kind of embracing, Ragh. 19, 32.
कण्ठ- + स्थानीय कण्ठ- + स्थानीय, adj. having [] its place in the throat, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 11.
